status: component-power rule frozen; no pilot input, simulation receipt, or selected seed count exists
reason: The pilot summary retains fourteen marginal upper dispersions but no paired component covariance. A simulated complete-member success count would therefore require an unidentified within-member dependence model for H1, H5, and H8.
componentSimulation: For every candidate, simulate each of the fourteen registered component tests separately for 30000 repetitions from its frozen alternative and eligible pilot input. Record a success only when that component's registered test and practical direction pass.
memberLowerBound: For each member, calculate max(0, 1 - sum over its components of (1 - simultaneous component lower power)).
familyLowerBound: Calculate max(0, 1 - sum over all fourteen components of (1 - simultaneous component lower power)). The first candidate at or above 0.90 and passing every reserve gate may be selected.
diagnosticAuthority: Complete-member and complete-family joint simulations under any declared dependence model are diagnostics only and cannot select a smaller N.
scientificTestUnchanged: The registered confirmatory analysis still has nine global-Holm members and component screening alpha 0.05/9. This amendment changes power-estimation uncertainty and dependence handling, not the scientific test family.
failureRule: Missing component counts, an unidentified dependence assumption, or failure of the component-union lower bound blocks selection. Do not substitute member or joint diagnostic power.
claimBoundary: This prospectively removes unidentified dependence from sample-size selection. It is not a pilot, power result, selected N, resource authorization, scientific finding, independent review, or publication result.
